text_block_list.text:
Upon arriving at the academy plaza, the 
passing students were all casting their 
eyes down, walking timidly as if afraid of 
something. The reason being――

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
W-Why has Kris S-senpai been standing over 
there the whole time...?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
How should I know...?! But she's giving 
off this insane, crushing pressure... 
Whatever you do, don't make eye contact!

――Is it a three-headed colossus lying in 
wait there? Or perhaps a great serpent 
destined to swallow the cosmos whole?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text: G-Gimlet-senpai...?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Nay, perhaps the petrifying gaze embedded 
within the Aegis itself. Why not veil that 
burning fighting spirit of yours, Kris S?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, did your soul yearn for it so dearly? 
For this duel――bound to shake the very 
foundations of Olympus!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――The fulfillment――of our contract.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my? How cold――or could it be? Have our 
roles reversed? Do you proclaim yourself 
to be Ares? To be the one who destroys, 
rampages, and tramples all underfoot?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――... That depends――on you.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Hahaha, hahahahahahaha!! Fascinating! 
You truly know how to make my blood surge!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Then there is no choice but to settle our 
supremacy! I shall prove it to you! That 
the God of Destruction is none other than 
myself!!

text_block_list.name: Murmuring Students
text_block_list.text:
W-What are those two planning to do...?! 
They said duel, but... are they seriously 
gonna brawl...?!

Worried that a real fight might break out, 
I followed after the two of them――only to 
arrive at the academy's racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now then, to pick up where we left off the 
other day, Kris S. What does "running" 
mean to you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Fulfilling――one's duty.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Dry and flavorless as always. What I 
believe running to be... is to 
"intoxicate."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
One's own legs. To plunge oneself, the 
audience, the gods, and the world itself 
into pure inebriation. That is what true 
"running" is.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: That is――... Your――answer.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Once more, we do not align. Though 
we stand as twin gods of war, our 
doctrines diverge completely.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Khahahaha!! Then let us decide! Whose 
pride will be the one shattered to dust!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: UOOOOHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Does glory await at the end of our 
path, or ultimate demise! Whichever it may 
be... this very moment is――!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ――Our reason for being!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Khahahaha! Ah, pure perfection! This is 
none other than the cocktail of chaos 
wrought by the clash of war gods!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That unyielding strength... that insane 
resolve constantly honing itself without 
end. You too are a truly magnificent 
vintage.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――As usual... ――You talk a lot.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
However――the strength you forged――is 
genuine. ――Your "aesthetic"――has depth.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ――Heh. Truly... exquisite.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――I gave it――everything I have right now――

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: ――It was a good match.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Kukuku, are you still not sufficiently 
intoxicated? Next time, let us change our 
palates and drink anew.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Yeah.

...And with that, the two departed. While 
there seemed to be a unique wavelength 
between them incomprehensible to 
outsiders――

――they were undoubtedly "worthy rivals" 
who fully acknowledged each other.
